task: Fix AI train soldier/scout commands lost in HTTP→gRPC flow; fix _UNIT_TYPE_MAP lowercase scout key
summary: Fixed AI train commands lost in HTTP→gRPC flow. Root causes: (1) grpc_client._snapshot_to_dict missing entity 'id' field inside value dict, (2) _UNIT_TYPE_MAP missing lowercase scout→Wraith, (3) production queue unlimited growth, (4) default player_races P2=protoss. All fixed. 11 Marines produced in 300-tick HTTP test.
